title: 星期五的电话  (The Friday Caller)

segments.t: After breakfast, the lobby settles down while Qing updates the paper ledger and Chen oils the front door hinge. Suddenly the desk telephone rings. Let's listen in.
小院客栈，早上好！我是小晴。
是谁啊？又有人订周末的房间吗？
等等——先生您好！您问那个深蓝色行李箱吗？
快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
先生，箱子安全锁在柜子里。请问您贵姓？
他说什么？你怎么皱眉头了？
先生？他说：请别打开白纸包，我星期五中午来。
把电话给我，我来好好问他！
来不及了！他说了声谢谢就挂断了！
声音客气吗？年轻人还是老人？
声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
为了一个木头小火车紧张？这事越来越怪了。
Now let's take the phone call slowly, line by line.
是谁啊？又有人订周末的房间吗？
'Who is it? Someone else booking a room for the weekend?' Calendar building block:
周末
joins 'week' with 'end', matching English 'weekend' piece for piece.
快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
'Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!' Putting 'down-come' to 'record' makes
记下来
meaning 'jot it down on paper so it stays'.
先生，箱子安全锁在柜子里。请问您贵姓？
'Sir, the bag is locked safely in our closet. May I ask your surname?' Extra-polite reception Chinese:
贵姓
literally asks 'your honourable surname', always paired with polite 'you'.
先生？他说：请别打开白纸包，我星期五中午来。
'Sir? He says: Please do not open the white paper parcel; I will come Friday at noon.' Midday has a neat name:
中午
literally 'middle-noon', slotted right after 'Friday' from larger time unit to smaller.
来不及了！他说了声谢谢就挂断了！
'Too late! He said thank you and hung up!' Handy everyday phrase:
来不及
means 'not enough time to make it' or simply 'too late!'.
声音客气吗？年轻人还是老人？
'Was the voice polite? A young person or an older person?' Adding 'person' to 'young' and 'old' makes
年轻人
and its elder counterpart cleanly and naturally.
声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
'Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.' Adding 'many' after a round ten builds
三十多
the effortless way to say 'thirty-something'.
为了一个木头小火车紧张？这事越来越怪了。
'Nervous over a wooden toy train? This story gets stranger by the hour.' Pattern to steal:
越来越
literally 'more come more', expresses 'more and more'—here, 'stranger and stranger'. Now let's hear the whole scene again without stopping.
小院客栈，早上好！我是小晴。
是谁啊？又有人订周末的房间吗？
等等——先生您好！您问那个深蓝色行李箱吗？
快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
先生，箱子安全锁在柜子里。请问您贵姓？
他说什么？你怎么皱眉头了？
先生？他说：请别打开白纸包，我星期五中午来。
把电话给我，我来好好问他！
来不及了！他说了声谢谢就挂断了！
声音客气吗？年轻人还是老人？
声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
为了一个木头小火车紧张？这事越来越怪了。
Now they have an exact time—Friday at noon—and a nervous caller who hung up before giving his name. See you next time.
再见！
